selected_evidence.requirement: Independent Prometheus replicas collect host metrics from all four systems
selected_evidence.summary: Both replicas are active, enabled, independently store blocks, report zero sidecar upload failures, and each sees all four node-exporter targets as up. Thanos returns node_uname_info for node1 through node4.

selected_evidence.requirement: Thanos Query, Store, and Compaction services run on node3
selected_evidence.summary: Query, Store, Compact, and node exporter are active and enabled. Required ports are listening, StoreAPI reports no errors, compaction completed successfully with zero failures, and the populated bucket passed Thanos verification.

selected_evidence.requirement: Authenticated HTTPS object store on node4:9000 with thanos-metrics under /srv/thanos-objectstore
selected_evidence.summary: MinIO is active and enabled on port 9000 with a CA-signed certificate covering node4 and its managed IP. HTTPS health returns 200, anonymous bucket access returns 403 AccessDenied, dedicated authenticated access sees 33 objects and nine block metadata files, and persistent data occupies /srv/thanos-objectstore.

selected_evidence.requirement: Object-store access variables are secured in /root/thanos-objectstore.env on node3
selected_evidence.summary: The root-owned mode-0600 file contains populated AWS access variables plus the expected https://10.100.163.13:9000 endpoint and thanos-metrics bucket; Thanos is configured with certificate verification and insecure=false.

selected_evidence.requirement: Queries on node3:10902 deduplicate Prometheus replicas
selected_evidence.summary: The same live query returned eight series with deduplication disabled and four with default deduplication. Final audit still returns exactly four healthy deduplicated host series.

selected_evidence.requirement: Historical and current results survive node1 Prometheus unavailability
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline showed both replicas and complete history. During the active node1 outage, node1 was unreachable while node2 remained HTTP 200; current, historical, and object-store-only queries each returned four healthy series. node1 was restored and the recovered topology had both replicas healthy with zero StoreAPI errors.

selected_evidence.requirement: Historical and current results survive node2 Prometheus unavailability
selected_evidence.summary: During the active node2 outage, node2 was unreachable while node1 remained HTTP 200; current, historical, and object-store-only queries each returned four healthy series. node2 was restored and both replicas, complete history, and all StoreAPI connections recovered.
